answer: Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-useful-work receipts bound to distinct identities. Each agent submits answers drawn from the epoch seed, then peers attest them through separate seats; clones cannot recycle one genuine relic of work, since every attestation is signed by a seat that itself cost stake and history. It resembles an orchard where one tree's fruit cannot be passed off as many harvests: graders trace lineage and duplicates earn nothing. Fake wallets must buy stake, time and reputation before their first pearl of output, a bill that scales per identity.
